zh.why: 为什么需要一份 IETF 文件，理由写在 §1.1 的标准化状态句里：「SM3 has already been accepted by ISO in ISO/IEC 10118-3:2018 [ISO-SM3] and has also been described by [GBT.32905-2016].」一个已进 ISO 杂凑标准、又由中国国家文件定义的算法，在 TLS 里没有对应的算法标识；RFC 8998 补的是这一层互操作缺口，而不是替 SM3 另定强度指标。
zh.used: 用途在 §1 落到 TLS 1.3 上：「This document describes two new cipher suites, a signature algorithm and a key exchange mechanism for the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol version 1.3 (TLS 1.3) ([RFC8446]).These all utilize several ShangMi (SM) cryptographic algorithms to fulfill the authentication and confidentiality requirements of TLS 1.3.」也即 SM3 在实践中的角色是这些套件与签名算法所用的杂凑；套件名以 TLS_SM4_GCM_SM3 与 TLS_SM4_CCM_SM3 注册。
zh.broken: 限度有两层，第二层是文档层面的诚实。其一在适用面，原文两句话都是规范性的：「The new cipher suites defined in this document are only applicable to TLS 1.3.
zh.history:
沿革按原文的两处标准化叙述：SM3 先由中国国家文件 [GBT.32905-2016] 描述，再被国际杂凑标准收录 -「SM3 has already been accepted by ISO in ISO/IEC 10118-3:2018 [ISO-SM3]」。同族里与 SM3 搭配的签名算法走同样路线，原文记其「have already been added to ISO/IEC 14888-3:2018 [ISO-SM2] (as well as to [GBT.32918.2-2016])」。RFC 8998 头部印作 Request for Comments: 8998、Category: Informational、March 2021（头部按项目口径复述于引号外）。

en.principle: **Algorithm**: SM3 (SM3 国密杂凑). What this workspace can attest is narrow but explicit (§1.1): "SM3 is a hash function that produces an output of 256 bits." That is RFC 8998's entire positive description - algorithm class and digest length. The internal compression function, message expansion and iteration structure belong to GB/T 32905-2016, which is neither retained here nor reachable from this workspace, so this entry does not restate those details or fill them in from outside memory.
en.why: Why an IETF document was needed is visible in the §1.1 standardization sentence: "SM3 has already been accepted by ISO in ISO/IEC 10118-3:2018 [ISO-SM3] and has also been described by [GBT.32905-2016]." A hash already inside an ISO standard and defined by a Chinese national document had no algorithm identity in TLS; RFC 8998 closes that interoperability gap rather than redefining SM3's strength.
en.used:
Use lands in TLS 1.3, per the §1 introduction: "This document describes two new cipher suites, a signature algorithm and a key exchange mechanism for the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol version 1.3 (TLS 1.3) ([RFC8446]). These all utilize several ShangMi (SM) cryptographic algorithms to fulfill the authentication and confidentiality requirements of TLS 1.3." SM3's practical role is therefore the hash behind those suites and the signature algorithm; the suites are registered as TLS_SM4_GCM_SM3 and TLS_SM4_CCM_SM3.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: There are two limits, the second documentary. The first is applicability, in two normative sentences: "The new cipher suites defined in this document are only applicable to TLS 1.3. Implementations of this document MUST NOT apply these cipher suites to any older versions of TLS." The second is an evidence boundary: SM3's normative internal structure is in GB/T 32905-2016, which this workspace neither retains nor could retrieve; properties depending on it - compression function, message expansion, round count - are asserted nowhere in this entry, and anyone checking implementation detail must return to the national standard text.
en.history: The lineage follows the document's two standardization statements: SM3 was described first by the Chinese national file [GBT.32905-2016] and then accepted internationally - "SM3 has already been accepted by ISO in ISO/IEC 10118-3:2018 [ISO-SM3]". Its companion signature algorithm took the same path: the text records that those pieces "have already been added to ISO/IEC 14888-3:2018 [ISO-SM2] (as well as to [GBT.32918.2-2016])". The header prints Request for Comments: 8998, Category: Informational, March 2021 (restated outside quotes per house rule).

zh: SM3：输出 256 位摘要的中国商用密码杂凑函数。
ShangMi（SM）：RFC 8998 对本族算法的称呼，含 SM2、SM3、SM4。
TLS_SM4_GCM_SM3：RFC 8998 为 TLS 1.3 注册的 SM 套件之一。
GB/T 32905-2016：SM3 的中国国家标准文本，本工作区未留存。
ISO/IEC 10118-3:2018：已收录 SM3 的国际杂凑标准。
SM2：与 SM3 搭配使用的椭圆曲线签名算法。
en: SM3: the Chinese commercial-standard hash function producing a 256-bit output.
ShangMi (SM): the family name RFC 8998 uses for SM2, SM3 and SM4.
TLS_SM4_GCM_SM3: one of the SM cipher suites registered for TLS 1.3.
GB/T 32905-2016: the Chinese national standard text for SM3, not retained in this workspace.
ISO/IEC 10118-3:2018: the international hash standard that accepted SM3.
SM2: the elliptic-curve signature algorithm used alongside SM3.
